answers:
In YOLOv8, the augmentation configuration can be found at ultralytics/yolo/cfg/default.yaml.
You can change the YAML file directly or set the parameter in model.train() as mentioned above.

nuggets.text: Augmentation parameters can be specified in YOLOv8 by modifying the ultralytics/yolo/cfg/default.yaml file.
Augmentation parameters can also be set in the model.train() function.
